name: payee-check
title: Payee Check
description: Payee form that asks your backend who holds the account and compares it with the typed name like Confirmation of Payee: match, close match with the real name one tap away, or no match with the name hidden and an explicit pay-anyway, plus first-payee and large-amount callouts.

meta.stops: Money sent to the wrong account
meta.summary: Asks the bank who holds an account and compares that with the name typed, like Confirmation of Payee, so money doesn't go to the wrong account.
meta.server: Run the name check and payment authorization on the server, and log pay-anyway acknowledgements.
catches: Typed name that doesn't match the account holder
Close matches and typos (Pirya vs Priya), titles and legal suffixes ignored
First payment to a new payee
Large first payments, with an optional test payment
limits: Needs a lookup backed by your bank or provider's name-check API
Name matching is fuzzy and can't settle every case
Doesn't stop a payer who chooses pay-anyway
a11y: Account, code and name inputs have visible labels
Name input has aria-invalid on no match and is described by a polite result region
Loading state has text; icons are aria-hidden
